mapper.sql: id, meter_id, meter_name,ip, port,address,type,up_region_id,total_positive_power, total_positive_reactive_power,total_negative_positive_power, create_time, create_person, update_time, update_person, is_deleted, total_positive_power_difference_value,total_positive_reactive_power_difference_value, total_negative_positive_power_difference_value,magnification_coefficient

meter_id, meter_name,ip, port,address,type,up_region_id,total_positive_power, total_positive_reactive_power,total_negative_positive_power, create_time, create_person, update_time, update_person, is_deleted, total_positive_power_difference_value,total_positive_reactive_power_difference_value, total_negative_positive_power_difference_value,magnification_coefficient
mapper.select: SELECT b.total_positive_power - a.total_positive_power AS totalPositivePowerDifferenceValue, b.total_positive_reactive_power - a.total_positive_reactive_power AS totalPositiveReactivePowerDifferenceValue, b.total_negative_positive_power - a.total_negative_positive_power AS totalNegativePositivePowerDifferenceValue FROM ( SELECT total_positive_power,total_positive_reactive_power, total_negative_positive_power FROM t_meter_log, (SELECT collect_power_time AS lastTime, id FROM t_meter WHERE id = #{id, jdbcType=INTEGER} )c WHERE meter_id = c.id AND create_time >= c.lastTime LIMIT 1 ) b, ( SELECT total_positive_power,total_positive_reactive_power, total_negative_positive_power FROM t_meter_log a, (SELECT DATE_FORMAT(DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(collect_power_time, INTERVAL 1 DAY),'%Y-%m-%d'),'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS lastTime, id FROM t_meter WHERE id = #{id, jdbcType=INTEGER} )d WHERE meter_id = d.id AND create_time >= d.lastTime LIMIT 1 ) a
mapper.delete: delete from t_meter_log WHERE create_time lt; DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH);
mapper.insert: insert into t_meter_log () values ( #{id}, #{name}, #{ip}, #{port}, #{address}, #{type},#{upRegionId}, #{totalPositivePower}, #{totalPositiveReactivePower}, #{totalNegativePositivePower}, now(), '0', now(), '0', 0, #{totalPositivePowerDifferenceValue}, #{totalPositiveReactivePowerDifferenceValue}, #{totalNegativePositivePowerDifferenceValue}, #{magnificationCoefficient} )
